versions.name: Main
versions.yaml:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  generateName: inlumen-pipeline-
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: inlumen-pipeline
    app.kubernetes.io/component: deployment-artifact
spec:
  entrypoint: inlumen-pipeline
  templates:
  - name: inlumen-pipeline
    dag:
      tasks:
      - name: step-1
        template: step-1
      - name: step-2
        template: step-2
        dependencies:
        - step-1
      - name: step-3
        template: step-3
        dependencies:
        - step-2
      - name: step-4
        template: step-4
        dependencies:
        - step-3
      - name: step-5
        template: step-5
        dependencies:
        - step-4
  - name: step-1
    metadata:
      annotations:
        inlumen.ai/flow-id: '1'
        inlumen.ai/type: input
        inlumen.ai/label: Ingestion
        inlumen.ai/dockerfile: Dockerfile.1
    container:
      image: inlumen/step-1:latest
      imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      workingDir: /app
      command:
      - python
      - -c
      - print('Executing inLUMEN Ingestion')
      env:
      - name: INLUMEN_FLOW_ID
        value: '1'
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_TYPE
        value: input
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_LABEL
        value: Ingestion
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_DESCRIPTION
        value: Collect remote patient vital signs
  - name: step-2
    metadata:
      annotations:
        inlumen.ai/flow-id: '2'
        inlumen.ai/type: action
        inlumen.ai/label: Preprocessing
        inlumen.ai/dockerfile: Dockerfile.2
    container:
      image: inlumen/step-2:latest
      imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      workingDir: /app
      command:
      - python
      - -c
      - print('Executing inLUMEN Preprocessing')
      env:
      - name: INLUMEN_FLOW_ID
        value: '2'
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_TYPE
        value: action
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_LABEL
        value: Preprocessing
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_DESCRIPTION
        value: Clean and normalize vital signs data
  - name: step-3
    metadata:
      annotations:
        inlumen.ai/flow-id: '3'
        inlumen.ai/type: action
        inlumen.ai/label: Model Training
        inlumen.ai/dockerfile: Dockerfile.3
    container:
      image: inlumen/step-3:latest
      imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      workingDir: /app
      command:
      - /bin/bash
      - /app/transcribe.sh
      env:
      - name: INLUMEN_FLOW_ID
        value: '3'
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_TYPE
        value: action
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_LABEL
        value: Model Training
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_DESCRIPTION
        value: Train model on historical patient data
      - name: INLUMEN_FILES
        value: '["transcribe.sh"]'
  - name: step-4
    metadata:
      annotations:
        inlumen.ai/flow-id: '4'
        inlumen.ai/type: output
        inlumen.ai/label: AI/ML Output
        inlumen.ai/dockerfile: Dockerfile.4
    container:
      image: inlumen/step-4:latest
      imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      workingDir: /app
      command:
      - python
      - -c
      - print('Executing inLUMEN AI/ML Output')
      env:
      - name: INLUMEN_FLOW_ID
        value: '4'
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_TYPE
        value: output
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_LABEL
        value: AI/ML Output
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_DESCRIPTION
        value: AI/ML pipeline results
  - name: step-5
    metadata:
      annotations:
        inlumen.ai/flow-id: '5'
        inlumen.ai/type: action
        inlumen.ai/label: Feature Engineering
        inlumen.ai/dockerfile: Dockerfile.5
    container:
      image: inlumen/step-5:latest
      imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      workingDir: /app
      command:
      - python
      - -c
      - print('Executing inLUMEN Feature Engineering')
      env:
      - name: INLUMEN_FLOW_ID
        value: '5'
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_TYPE
        value: action
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_LABEL
        value: Feature Engineering
      - name: INLUMEN_STEP_DESCRIPTION
        value: Generate or select features for model input
